to-name: To an Unknown Woman

Dear Madam
I am much obliged by your paper on Clothes for the poor, and would willingly put it in at once, but I am afraid that the great want of space will delay it and also the payment for it for some time[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: This letter should date from before Walter Smith’s move from Paternoster Row in 1881.
